payload.entry: Bob logs-visibility: reading mode condenses SCHEDULE LOG to moved N× (entries only), WORK LOG to newest WORKED LogRow plus +N older, and hides CANCEL LOG; include_closed prints full logs on open and restored closed tasks. Done/canceled subtrees are omitted with one count each (descendants cannot escape) or restored in a compact Closed tasks appendix with completion/cancelled date chips. Self-snapshot #ref tasks whose linked note source_note resolves to the root are omitted in both modes and counted separately. Anchors rebuild from surviving body plus appendix. Verified cargo test --lib note_snapshot (123 passed), including six statuses, nested closed, omitted/restored links, log punctuation, full logs, both self-ref modes, CountingLoader one-read-per-source, and unchanged source bytes/hashes. sase bead epic-symbols: none.
